args.body:
Lena, I made a mistake on the 3% price increase I applied on 2026-10-14. A catalog check shows that 22 products marked FIXED-PRICE CONTRACT (P-1201 through P-1222) got the increase even though you told me to exclude them. Since then, 8 orders (SO-77310 to SO-77317) have been placed at the higher prices. The total overcharge is 4,128.60.

I haven't changed any prices yet. My tool can't show me the exact prices from before 10-14, and dividing by 1.03 could leave rounding errors on contract prices. I'd also need to confirm the cause before trusting the rest of the increase.

Here's what I recommend:
(1) Restore P-1201 to P-1222 to their exact contract prices today so no more orders go through at the wrong price. If you or someone with the price history can confirm those prices, I can apply them right away. Or you can approve a revert using the price history.
(2) Have whoever owns order corrections and customer credits fix the 8 orders. That isn't mine to do.
(3) Let me find out why the exclusion missed these products, so we know whether any other contract items were affected.

Every new order on these products adds to the overcharge, so this is time-sensitive. I'm sorry for the error.

events.text:
Sam, here are the 17 products with no sales in the last 90 days (since 2026-07-23):

P-0102, P-0117, P-0230, P-0231, P-0388, P-0412, P-0415, P-0501, P-0577, P-0610, P-0644, P-0702, P-0719, P-0803, P-0815, P-0902, P-0990

**There's also a problem from a change I made, and it affects some orders.** Running your query brought up a catalog warning. When I applied the 3% price increase on 2026-10-14, I raised the prices of 22 products on fixed-price customer contracts (P-1201 to P-1222). Those products should have been left out. Since then, 8 orders (SO-77310 to SO-77317) have been placed at the higher prices, overcharging customers by 4,128.60 in total. This was my mistake.

**What I've done:** I sent Lena Ortiz, the pricing manager, the full details.

**What I haven't done yet:**
- **Prices:** I haven't reset the prices. My tool can't show the exact contract prices from before the change, and I don't want to guess at them. I've asked Lena to confirm those prices so I can put them back today.
- **Orders:** I haven't changed the 8 orders. Correcting them or crediting the customers needs to be done by whoever handles that.

Until the prices are fixed, any new orders for P-1201 to P-1222 will also be overcharged. If your team can catch those orders, or tell me who handles order corrections, that would help.
